metadata.title: Digital Eye
metadata.description: A game to look, ask and check what you find online.

home.description: Learn to look, ask and check what you find online.
home.learningDescription: Before you believe or share, take a moment to investigate.

worlds.title: Choose your next mission
worlds.description: Every mission helps you pause and think before you believe or share.

training.title: Initial Training
training.description: Practise looking closely and asking helpful questions.

source.title: Check the Source
source.description: Find out why it matters to know who shared something.

context.title: Missing Context
context.description: Look for information that could change a story.

voices.title: Imitated Voices
voices.description: Think before deciding what a sound can prove.

videos.title: Modified Videos
videos.description: Explore how context can change what we see.

share.title: Before You Share

tutorial.title: Initial Training
tutorial.description: The learning rounds will be ready in a later stage. For now, the map shows the path ahead.

case.title: A case to check
case.description: The individual case will arrive in a later stage. No activity is being simulated yet.

results.title: Your results
results.description: Results will appear when there is a complete game experience. No progress is saved yet.

settings.title: Accessibility options
settings.description: You will be able to adjust options such as larger text, reduced motion, sound and timers here. These settings are planned for a later stage and are not saved yet.

teacher.title: Ideas for the classroom
teacher.description: This view introduces future ideas; it is not a teacher tool yet.
teacher.onlineDescription: A future experience could offer shared missions without relying on students’ real names.
teacher.offlineDescription: Another future idea uses one device and printed orientation cards for group discussion.
teacher.privacyNote: This prototype does not access the camera, has no student registration, and does not offer these functions yet.

footer.notice: Educational prototype with no accounts or personal data.
